question: What caused INC-0338?
expected_answer: DEP-0248 (shipping PR-1411) introduced the regression: Deployment DEP-0248 (cart-service v2.7.20) shipped PR-1411 "Fail fast on slow upstreams in cart-service" (commit 5582301), which changed `services/cart-service/deploy/cart-service.yaml`. `HTTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` dropped from 1.0s to 0.25s and retries rose from 2 to 4.
